what: §7.3b boost-placement-duel (P1-S09): the same boost spent on the straight beats it spent in the corner. Five Cruz Missiles enter the greybox hairpin at 18 m/s, three on the autopilot's line (the same line for all), the ACTION stick the only difference. plain: no boost. straight: the starting meter (1.4 s of boost) spent on the straight before the corner. corner: the same boost spent through the corner. mash: two seeded random scripts. Gate: 110 m along the route.
